body.statement: Conditional on an affirmative construction in \(\mathrm{oeq:smooth\text{-}splice}\), \(\inf_{\widetilde\Gamma_N\in\mathfrak E_{\Gamma,N}}\sup_{P\in\mathcal M_\star}\mathbb E_{P^{\otimes N}}\|\widetilde\Gamma_N-\Gamma(P)\|_{\mathrm{op}}\asymp(\log N)^{-1}\) and \(\inf_{\widetilde\Theta_N\in\mathfrak E_{\Theta,N}}\sup_{P\in\mathcal M_\star}\mathbb E_{P^{\otimes N}}d_H(\widetilde\Theta_N,\Theta_{TY}(\Gamma(P),\preceq))\asymp(\log N)^{-1}\). Moreover, for every \((S_N)\in\mathfrak C_\alpha(\mathcal M_\star)\), the constructed collision laws satisfy \(\liminf_{N\to\infty}P_{0,N}^{\otimes N}\{\operatorname{diam}(S_N)\ge|b(s_N)-b(0)|\}\ge1-2\alpha\), where \(P_{0,N},P_{1,N}\in\mathcal M_{\mathrm{col}}\) and \(|b(s_N)-b(0)|\asymp(\log N)^{-1}\).
body.justification: The conditional implication makes the precise statistical consequences of the unresolved analytic construction auditable without asserting that construction as settled.
body.gap: Belomestny--Trabs--Tsybakov proves a covariance minimax theorem; conditional on the displayed fixed-class pair, this statement adds singleton causal-effect loss and a quantified honest-confidence diameter event on an exact collision stratum.
body.consumer: Once the open construction is verified, it prevents an IDA implementation from advertising uniformly faster mixed-noise effect precision by order selection or collision testing.
